intentions.title: Give Next.js App Router apps a first-class, idiomatic Barkpark integration (server fetch, actions, draft mode, webhook, revalidate, preload, live-reload) instead of forcing consumers onto the raw core client
intentions.evidence: Distinct subpath exports client/server/webhook/draft-mode/revalidate/preload/actions (js/CLAUDE.md 'Package map'); each factory (createBarkparkServer, createWebhookHandler, createDraftModeRoutes, createPreloader, defineActions) documents an App Router route.ts/page.tsx drop-in example.

intentions.title: Keep cache-tag invalidation correct end-to-end across write (Server Actions), read (server fetch), and webhook-driven revalidation by deriving every tag from one shared formatter
intentions.evidence: tag-prefix.ts's formatTagPrefix is imported by actions/defineActions.ts (fanOutTags), server/core.ts (resolveTagPrefix), and revalidate/index.ts (tagPrefix) — comments explicitly say this keeps write/read/revalidate tags identical; supports both SCOPED bp:ws:*:p:*:ds:* (s7) and LEGACY flat bp:ds:* shapes.

intentions.title: Never drop a webhook-driven revalidation under retry/duplicate delivery — treat webhook mutation as an idempotent, at-least-once operation
intentions.evidence: webhook/index.ts's settledDeliveries LRU + inFlightDeliveries promise map: a concurrent same-id delivery awaits the in-flight promise rather than assuming duplicate, and a failed onMutation rolls back the reservation so retries re-run instead of being silently swallowed as deduped.

intentions.title: Support authenticated preview/draft editing (Sanity-style draft mode) with signed, time-limited preview URLs and automatic token reissue on expiry
intentions.evidence: draft-mode/index.ts: signDraftModeToken (HMAC over path+expiry, 10-min TTL) + createDraftModeRoutes GET/DELETE handlers with one reissuePreviewToken retry before 401; server/core.ts barkparkFetchInner branches on draftMode().isEnabled to force cache:'no-store' + perspective=drafts + Bearer auth, with its own 401-retry-then-throw.

intentions.title: Make Server Actions the safe, validated, tag-fanned-out way to mutate Barkpark documents from Next.js — schema-validated writes that automatically invalidate the right caches
intentions.evidence: actions/defineActions.ts: createDoc/patchDoc/publish/unpublish/discardDraft/deleteDoc each parse via an optional Zod-shaped schema then revalidateTag the canonical doc/type tags; useOptimisticDocument.ts layers useOptimistic+useTransition+conflict surfacing (ETag ifMatch, BarkparkConflictError) on top for optimistic UI.

intentions.title: Guarantee correctness under Next.js's edge-vs-node and RSC-vs-client runtime boundaries rather than silently breaking at build or request time
intentions.evidence: client/live.tsx's three-layer detectEdgeRuntime()/assertNotEdge() throws BarkparkEdgeRuntimeError instead of silently failing SSE; server/core.ts deliberately does NOT re-export BarkparkLive to avoid pulling React.createContext into the react-server graph (documented crash: 'is not a function'); comment in core.ts warns cache:'no-store' + next.tags together silently breaks revalidateTag on Next 15.5.15.

intentions.title: Eliminate duplicate document fetches within a single request via request-scoped preloading (parallel data fetching pattern)
intentions.evidence: preload/index.ts createPreloader wraps barkparkFetch in a dedup Map + React cache(); extensive doc comment warns against module-scoping the preloader (would leak stale documents cross-request) and mandates binding via React's cache() per request.
